data_sources.type: Text Analytics for health-style JSON output with report provenance

transformation_logic: Normalize field names and formats without replacing missing source identifiers.
Apply scenario de-identification rules while preserving or consistently remapping identifiers required for linkage.
Preserve report_id on every NLP-derived record so extracted entities remain traceable to the source report.
Validate report-to-study linkage using the supplied request/order, accession, patient/encounter, and study-reference evidence. Do not equate accession number with DICOM Study Instance UID.
Retain unresolved records with an explicit review status; do not fabricate identifiers or silently drop linkage failures.
Preserve returned NLP confidenceScore values as model-output quality evidence; do not treat them as clinical severity or apply a universal clinical threshold.

governed_dataset_connection.lineage: Retain source filename, report_id, order/accession references, and DICOM Study Instance UID where available
governed_dataset_connection.access_note: Use the bounded, de-identified scenario package only

downstream_output_consumer: Radiology AI model evaluation team / Microsoft Foundry scenario workflow

quality_handling.missing_identifier: Flag unresolved and preserve source evidence
quality_handling.linkage_mismatch: Do not force join; route for reconciliation
quality_handling.nlp_quality_issue: Document against source report and regenerate/reprocess only after the issue is identified
